{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && mkdir -p specs/001-transactions/checklists && cat > specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md <<'EOF'
# Specification Quality Checklist: Tagged Cache (cachetools.tagged.TaggedCache)

**Purpose**: Validate specification completeness and quality before proceeding to planning
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

## Content Quality

- [x] No implementation details (languages, frameworks, APIs)
  - Note: spec names the public API contract only (put/get/invalidate,
    ValueError/KeyError/TypeError as required observable behavior). Internal
    design (e.g., using the existing LRUCache internally) is deliberately
    left to the plan phase. "cachetools.tagged" appears only as the
    additive module name in scope/assumptions.
- [x] Focused on user value and business needs
- [x] Written for non-technical stakeholders
  - Note: domain vocabulary of a caching library (deep copy, hashable,
    LRU recency) is unavoidable; every story is framed as a consumer
    journey in plain language.
- [x] All mandatory sections completed

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain (verified by grep: none)
- [x] Requirements are testable and unambiguous (FR-001..FR-016 each state
  inputs and observable outcomes, incl. state-preservation guarantees)
- [x] Success criteria are measurable (SC-001..SC-005 use exact counts,
  percentages, and zero-failure gates)
- [x] Success criteria are technology-agnostic (reference project acceptance
  mechanisms, not implementation tech)
- [x] All acceptance scenarios are defined (3 prioritized stories, 15
  Given/When/Then scenarios)
- [x] Edge cases are identified (9 edge cases: dedup, empty tags, bare
  string, non-string tag, replacement tag swap, eviction cleanup, get
  refresh, len accuracy, unhashable keys)
- [x] Scope is clearly bounded (Out of Scope section: Claim-A extension
  deferred; thread safety/persistence/serialization excluded; no changes to
  existing classes)
- [x] Dependencies and assumptions identified (deep-copy semantics, tag
  validation order, unhashable-key contract, recency baseline, acceptance
  suite authority)

## Feature Readiness

- [x] All functional requirements have clear acceptance criteria (R01 ->
  FR-001..FR-008 -> Story 1; R02 -> FR-009..FR-013 -> Story 2; R03 ->
  FR-014..FR-016 -> Story 3)
- [x] User scenarios cover primary flows (P1 store/retrieve, P2
  invalidate/LRU, P3 configuration/atomicity)
- [x] Feature meets measurable outcomes defined in Success Criteria
- [x] No implementation details leak into specification

## Notes

- All items pass on first validation iteration (2026-10-17).
- The Claim-A candidate extension (put recency refresh, variant
  put_no_recency_refresh, 2026-09-21) is intentionally OUT of the baseline
  scope and is recorded as a deferred intent in spec.md "Out of Scope" and
  in Assumptions; it must be explicitly adopted in a later phase before
  implementation.
- No clarifications were needed: every ambiguity had a documented informed
  default in Assumptions.
EOF
echo CHECKLIST_OK; printf '{\n  "feature_directory": "specs/001-transactions"\n}\n' > .specify/feature.json && cat .specify/feature.json && python -c "import json;print(json.load(open('.specify/feature.json')))""}
